keyLimits.en: 3 active projects, 1 workflow, 1 package template, 1 automation, 100GB storage, 1.5% payment processing fee on cards/ACH
Unlimited projects, workflows, packages and automations, 500GB storage, no payment processing fee
All Standard features plus team member management and removal of Bloom branding, 1TB storage

addOns.en: Custom client-facing website: $17 each, available on all plans

cautions.en: The $7/$17/$33 monthly figures shown at signup are a promotional 50%-off rate for the first 12 months on annual billing, not the standing annual price.
Starter plan charges an extra 1.5% payment processing fee on card/ACH transactions that higher tiers don't.

capabilities.en: CRM and client portal built for creative freelancers and small studios (photographers, designers) covering leads, invoicing, contracts and scheduling in one workflow.
Built-in client galleries and package/pricing templates for delivering creative work.
Automations and multi-step workflows to move clients from lead to booked project.
Built-in messenger for client communication inside the portal.

limitations.en: Starter tier caps active projects at 3 and limits workflows, packages and automations to 1 each, making it unsuitable beyond very light side-job use.
Team member management only becomes available on the top (Plus) tier.
No permanent free plan; only a 7-day trial is offered before billing starts.

reason.en: Closest direct competitor: CRM and client management built for the same creative-freelancer audience.
Similar all-in-one client management, invoicing and workflow tool for solo creative businesses.

unknowns: Standing (non-promotional) annual price per plan after the first 12 months was not shown explicitly on the pricing page.
Whether the Plus plan has a per-seat minimum or a flat team price beyond the base seat was not fully detailed.
